newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two die as Russian ship sinks off Japan.
newsitem.headline: Two die as Russian ship sinks off Japan.

text.p: A Russian cargo ship has sunk in the Sea of Japan, killing two crew members and injuring the captain, officials at Japan's Maritime Safety Agency (MSA) said on Saturday.
The 1,439 ton Pulsar capsized and sank in rough seas at 2100 GMT on Friday off Japan's northernmost main island of Hokkaido after its load of lumber came loose, officials said.
An MSA patrol boat rescued the ship's captain, Nikolai Nikolaevich, whose condition was serious but was rapidly improving.
The MSA vessel retrieved the bodies of two dead crew, one of whom has been identified as the ship's chief engineer, Sergey Andrianov.
The remaining 21 crew members were rescued by another Russian ship which had answered the mayday message. The hour-long rescue was impeded by rough seas, agency officials said.

The sinking happened about 65 miles northwest of the Shakotan Peninsula in western Hokkaido, south of the disputed island territories of Sakhalin. The Russian vessel was bound for the port city of Rumoi, in western Hokkaido.
